verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's quickstart says the OpenAI SDK can be pointed at OpenRouter as a drop-in replacement, and its API reference says it normalizes one schema across models and providers. Together these cover the core of re-pointing existing OpenAI-compatible code at the gateway. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that only the base URL and API key need to change (no base URL value or migration example in the evidence), independent hands-on confirmation that OpenAI SDK code works unchanged.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible code at the gateway by changing only the base URL and key

citations.quote: You can also use the OpenAI SDK pointed at OpenRouter as a drop-in replacement.
OpenRouter normalizes the schema across models and providers so you only need to learn one.
OpenRouter gives you access to hundreds of AI models through a single API endpoint.
